hooks.command: jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("^[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]].*(&&|;)")) then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "Do not start a command with cd ... && or cd ... ;. Run one simple command with absolute paths instead (AGENTS.md section 4). Prefer the Read and Grep tools for reading and searching."}} else empty end'

jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("^[[:space:]]*(for|while|until)[[:space:]]")) then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "Do not run shell loops (for, while, until): the shell parser cannot analyze them and the Product Owner is prompted every time (AGENTS.md section 4). Use the tool own repeat option, for example playwright --repeat-each=N, or separate tool calls."}} else empty end'

jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("[&][&]|[|][|]")) then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "Do not chain commands with && or || (AGENTS.md section 4). Run each command in its own Bash call."}} else empty end'

jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("(^|[^-=<>&0-9])[0-9]?>>?[[:space:]]*(?!&|/dev/null)[^[:space:]]|<<")) then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "Do not write files through shell redirection or heredocs (AGENTS.md section 4). Use the Write or Edit tool for files, the scratchpad directory for temporary files, and several -m flags for multi-line commit messages. Redirection to /dev/null and 2>&1 stay allowed."}} else empty end'

jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("(^|[[:space:]])find[[:space:]].*[[:space:]]-(exec|execdir|ok|okdir|delete)([[:space:]]|$)")) then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "Do not run find with -exec, -ok, or -delete (AGENTS.md section 4). Use find only to list paths, then act on them with the dedicated tools."}} else empty end'
